description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio WriteBuffer task, testing buffer writing behavior with mock GstWrapper, including handling of buffer allocation, partial writes, and error conditions.

classes.name: WebAudioWriteBufferTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudio WriteBuffer unit tests, setting up mock context and GstWrapper.

methods.name: WebAudioWriteBufferTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing test context and mock GstWrapper.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForAllData
methods.description: Test that the buffer is written completely when sufficient space is available.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForAllMainDataAndPartialWrapData
methods.description: Test partial wrap data write when buffer space is limited.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForPartialMainDataAndNoWrapData
methods.description: Test partial main data write with no wrap data available.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfNewAllocateFails
methods.description: Test behavior when buffer allocation fails.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferIfBytesWrittenLessThanExpected
methods.description: Test partial buffer write when less data is written than expected.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfPushBufferFails
methods.description: Test behavior when gstAppSrcPushBuffer returns an error.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfBytesToWriteLessThanBytesPerSample
methods.description: Test that no write occurs if bytes to write are less than bytes per sample.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferThatNotAlignedWithBytesPerSample
methods.description: Test buffer write when data size is not aligned with bytes per sample.
